LAWFUL_FEATURE_GATE.formula: eligible=enabled AND all(inputs); grants nothing until the ordinary typed command commits

CONTACT_WORK.formula: required=ceil(parameter*actualQuantityNumerator/quantityDenominator); progress=min(actualCompleted,required); do not rescale historical completed work

ELAPSED_WORK.formula: due=actualStartTick+parameter; complete iff nowTick>=due and actual environmental prerequisites continued; elapsed is not extra Actor work

MEASUREMENT_BOUND.formula: bound=parameter*measurementScale; actual contact observation residual is bounded by bound; accept against permittedBoundary using recorded observation and confidence, not unobserved World truth

FINITE_LOSS_Q.formula: lost,remainder=divmod(actualInputOrSourceQuantity*clamp(parameter,0,10000)+savedRemainder,10000); usable=actualInputOrSourceQuantity-lost; each lost unit has a LossReceipt; never use lost quantities twice

RECOVER_EXISTING_Q.formula: recovered,remainder=divmod((actualDamagedRecoverableMass-irrecoverableFloorMass)*parameter+savedRemainder,10000); recovered cannot exceed actual reserve and requires repair work/input; new damage state only after receipt

ENERGY_RATE.formula: required,remainder=divmod(parameter*actualMovedOrWorkedQuantity+savedRemainder,quantityDenominator); actual operation only with stored productive energy >= required; debit once, never energy created by parameter

THROUGHPUT.formula: handled=min(parameter*actualCompletedContactWork,actualAvailableSourceQuantity,actualReceivingCapacity); handling transfers only real source quantity by unique receipt

SPACE_PER_UNIT.formula: limit=floor(actualUsableAreaOrClearance/parameter); admit only actuallyReservedUnits<=limit and actual nonoverlapping geometry; reduced nominal spacing cannot waive tree canopy or paths

CAPACITY_LIMIT.formula: limit=min(parameter,actualMeasuredSupportLimit); admit iff request+actualReservedCapacity<=limit; capacity is not inventory or person creation

MINIMUM_INTERFACE.formula: eligible=actualAvailableClearanceOrCondition>=parameter; actual body and support gates still apply

MISFIRE_THRESHOLD.formula: threshold=clamp(parameter+floor((10000-actualConditionQ)/5)+min(2000,floor(actualWetExposureQ/5)),0,6000); misfire=savedWeaponEventDrawQ<threshold; consume one actual loaded charge on attempt, dud has no projectile, paid30tick clear before new load

MAXIMUM_CONDITION.formula: eligible=actualMeasuredWetnessOrRisk<=parameter; unsafe contact is refused even when equipment exists

ENERGY_Q_FACTOR.formula: required,remainder=divmod(actualBaseEnergyCost*parameter+savedRemainder,10000); debit actual energy once only for actual work/distance; no charge on unrealized plan

existing_sources.growth_source_mass_equation: 6000g explicit biomass +6000g ecological water capacity =>6000g new fruit+6000g named evap/residue per actual daily receipt; max14 receipts

first_sample_trace.first_4_days_goal: each real source trip/contact/food and fabrication assigned to one existing Actor interval; no sum-work-only proof

bootstrap.daily_energy_not_independent_maxima: 300000 absorbed is combined basal+actual loaded movement+actual productive work envelope, not guaranteed 4000WU plus arbitrary routes; load uses life maximum_load_g and actual carried recursive mass

monetary_initialization.right_value_snapshot: verifiedUnpaidWorkUnits*10 is frozen monetary right value; settled_minor_units may be partial; outstanding_right_value_minor_units preserved until actual later payment
monetary_initialization.failure_state: NO_CURRENCY_if_prepare_or_commit_fails_no_partly_issued_cash; sameEvent replay returns old receipt; concurrent differentEvent sameScope rejected

TreeFruitBatch.placement_maturity: GodVegetationSource juvenile fruit0; mature CreationEcology must explicitly configure and debit budget

prototype_parameter_generation.owner: social ResearchProject ExperimentWIP actual sample ledger, economic funds only
inputs: actual experimental design proposal parameter version
prototype_parameter_generation.material_quality: minimum actual consumed critical material batch quality_q, not offered seller claim
prototype_parameter_generation.qualified_skill: actual relevant research skill at sample WorkReceipt; personality is not a skill multiplier
prototype_parameter_generation.slot_formula: actual=base+truncTowardZero((variant-base)*materialQualityQ*qualifiedSkillQ/100000000); clamp declared min/max; no nominal variant assignment
prototype_parameter_generation.family_formula: actual=base+orientationWorse*ceil(max(1,base)*(10000-min(materialQualityQ,qualifiedSkillQ))/10000); clamp declared min/max; input quality determines actual sample before observation
prototype_parameter_generation.orientationWorse: loss/error/work/energy/wear/minimum-requirement quantities +1; capacity/throughput/tolerance ranges -1; stored explicitly per parameter
prototype_parameter_generation.observation: observed=actual+saved contact residual e(cursor); actual measured physical value remains in sample record; sameSample replay same residual; resolution-limited result cannot claim exact better bound
prototype_parameter_generation.receipt_partition: N actual samples use disjoint debit portions floor(totalInput/N), remainder distributed by sample cursor; sum material debit equals node input budget, no sample twice; work floor(totalWork/N) with remaining ticks assigned once
prototype_parameter_generation.sample_retry: new SampleId requires new reserved funds/material/contact/time; repeated validate on old sample is not new evidence
